description: What's going around. Any country: outbreaks the World Health Organization reported there in the past 12 months (Disease Outbreak News). A US state, this week, from CDC open data: the state's acute respiratory illness level, wastewater levels for COVID, flu A and RSV at a typical site with the direction over three weeks (and the sites serving a county when one is given), and whether measles or H5 bird flu was found in the state's wastewater in the last four weeks. Use for 'is flu going around', 'is COVID up', measles worries before travel or school, and visiting someone vulnerable. Send the state, and the county if known. Community levels, not medical advice or anyone's personal risk. Not for health notices abroad (use check_trip).

country.description: Any other country, for WHO outbreak reports; leave out for the US

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, e.g. 'WA'

name: check_illness
title: Illness: what's going around
